description: The MICRO 2026 tutorial's code beside PyTorchSim: Coprocessor's tutorial branch, the hands-on's start with its answer in examples/xlane_reduce/answer/, and the Coprocessor environment image whose RISC-V toolchain (clang among it) its tests assemble with. docker/Dockerfile.tutorial checks the branch out in /workspace/Coprocessor at this commit and builds it; the image's PYTORCHSIM_VCIX_BUILD is that build, so the models Spike and the compiler load are the attendee's.
